entities.summary: Boaz Toporovsky is an Israeli politician. A former chair of the National Union of Israeli Students, he served as a member of the Knesset for Yesh Atid between 2013 and 2015 and has been a member of the Knesset again since 2019. He served as the coalition whip and chair in the 24th Knesset. He is currently head of the Yesh Atid parliamentary group and opposition coordinator.
